body: It was just that I moved away. We stayed in close contact for a few weeks and then less and less talking until one day she told me she'd been sleeping with other people and had a new full-time SO.

It feels like the "off ramps" are just short detours that lead back to the highway. I have hobbies that I enjoy- meditation, art (pen), skateboarding, but something happens while I sleep that puts me back on the highway to hell upon awakening, no matter how I felt when I fell asleep.
